entries.subject: ESO eso0930a
entries.finding: The Trifid Nebula: B, V, R and H-alpha; 2432 × 2432 px over 13.89 × 13.89 arcmin. The file's embedded sky tags, used as they are: 0.3426 arcsec per pixel, north 0.2° left of vertical, the window's centre at 270.5770458°, -23.0163803°. Not measured against Gaia here.

entries.subject: The shape of the Trifid Nebula
entries.finding: The picture is flat. Depth needs the nebula's shape as a paper gives it; none was found for this star-forming region on 2026-10-03.
entries.revisitWhen: A paper prints a three-dimensional shape of the nebula.

entries.subject: Stars in the picture
entries.finding: The photograph first kept its stars, which stood on the nebula's plane whatever their own distances. The Nebula Lab's NOX removes them and keeps the nebula's structure. One pass left the saturated stars, tens of pixels wide; a second pass over a quarter-size copy takes them, and the picture takes that pass's result only where it took a star.
